title: TEMI Robot Cognitive Support System
summary: A Computer Science student project that combines the Temi robot, AI image recognition (YOLO) and smart-home sensors to assess cognitive abilities through interactive scenarios.
description:
The **TEMI Robot-Based Cognitive Support System** combines the **Temi** robot, AI image recognition (**YOLO**) and smart-home sensors to assess patients' cognitive abilities through interactive scenarios.

The evaluation is **automated, adaptive and engaging**, and it reduces the need for close human supervision. Real-time analysis and dynamic scenario management give patients personalized feedback and performance scores.

The project combines robotics, AI and smart-home technology for cognitive healthcare. It was developed and tested in the [HIT Living Lab](/projects/hit-living-lab).
